title: Field and Model Validators
summary: Constraints, field validators and before and after model validators, in the order Pydantic runs them. Move the rules of a sign-up form into its model: normalize the email, reject mismatched passwords with a custom error naming both fields, accept a legacy key without mutating the input, and return errors that never echo a password.

resources.label: Pydantic 2.12: Error handling and custom errors
